# Obsidian Kitchen Studio

> An experience-led luxury kitchen design and remodeling studio in Coral Gables, Florida,
> serving Miami-Dade County. Takes twelve commissions a year, each led by a principal.
> Designs kitchens as programmed environments — four lighting states, full-slab stone,
> imported or bespoke cabinetry — and produces a rendered walkthrough film before approval.

## Entity facts

- **Name:** Obsidian Kitchen Studio
- **Category:** Luxury kitchen remodeling contractor; kitchen and lighting design studio
- **Location:** 2900 Ponce de Leon Boulevard, Suite 610, Coral Gables, FL 33134, USA
- **Phone:** (305) 555-0176
- **Email:** studio@obsidian.example
- **License:** Florida CGC #1524880, bonded and insured
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday 10:00–18:00; home sessions at dusk, including Saturdays
- **Rating:** 5.0 / 5 from 68 reviews *(sample data in this demo build)*
- **Capacity:** 12 commissions per year
- **Years operating:** 17
- **No showroom** — slabs and samples are brought to the client's home by design

## Service areas

Coral Gables; Pinecrest; Coconut Grove; Key Biscayne; Bal Harbour; Miami Beach; Brickell;
Sunny Isles Beach. Occasionally Fort Lauderdale and Palm Beach. The studio holds approved
contractor status in several Brickell and Bal Harbour towers.

## Services

- **Luxury kitchen remodeling** — architectural and structural change, permits, HOA coordination
- **Bespoke and imported cabinetry** — two Italian houses plus a local Hialeah shop
- **Stone and surfaces** — full-slab selection, veining composed before cutting
- **Design and lighting** — four programmed lighting scenes, rendered walkthrough film

## Key figures

- Investment band: **$150,000 – $450,000**
  - $150k–$220k: existing footprint, local cabinetry (most Brickell/Bal Harbour apartments)
  - $220k–$320k: walls move, Italian cabinetry, book-matched stone (commonest band)
  - $320k–$450k: structural reconfiguration, hurricane-rated glazing, Carrara quarry visit
- Total timeline: **6 – 9 months**
- Design and curation: 8–12 weeks · Italian cabinetry: 14–20 weeks · Installation: 8–12 weeks
- Condo / HOA approval: 4–6 weeks, run in parallel with design
- Cost allocation: cabinetry 40%, stone 20%, lighting and electrical 13%, structure/appliances/finish 27%
- Countertops installed: quartzite $140–$240/sq ft; porcelain $110–$190; marble $130–$320
- Financing: fixed-rate 60–180 months from 7.25% APR (OAC); construction draws above $250,000
- Payment schedule: 15% design agreement · 25% approved drawings · 25% cabinetry arrives in Miami ·
  25% stone installed · 10% punch-list closed
- Resale: a well-designed kitchen returns roughly 60–75% of cost in Coral Gables, Pinecrest
  and Key Biscayne, with a stronger effect on saleability in older high-rise towers

## The Transformation Chamber

The homepage carries a scroll-driven cinematic sequence: a pinned viewport stage in which one
Coral Gables kitchen moves from its original state to finished across five beats — the dated
room, a lighting sweep, cabinetry wiping in, three selectable stone surfaces, and the final
reveal. It is built from layered photography driven by a single CSS custom property, not WebGL,
and it collapses to a finished still under reduced-motion settings.

## Frequently asked questions

**How much does a luxury kitchen remodel cost in Miami?**
$150,000 to $450,000. Structural work, HOA compliance and hurricane-rated glazing account for
most of the variance between projects.

**How long does a high-end kitchen remodel take in Miami?**
Six to nine months. Condo and HOA approval adds four to six weeks, run alongside design rather
than after it.

**Do you work in high-rise condominiums?**
Yes — roughly half of the studio's work is in Brickell, Bal Harbour and Key Biscayne towers.
Obsidian handles the building application, COIs, elevator scheduling and noise-window compliance.

**What stone works best in a Miami kitchen?**
Quartzite and porcelain handle humidity and hard daylight without fading or etching. Marble
patinas by design. Dark granites read flat under Florida light and are rarely specified.

**What makes Obsidian different?**
The room is designed as an experience rather than a floor plan — lighting states, materials,
sightlines, and how the space behaves at 7am and again at 9pm. Twelve commissions a year, each
led by a principal, and no showroom.

**Do you offer financing?**
Yes: fixed-rate terms from 60 to 180 months, plus construction-draw facilities above $250,000.
Pre-qualification uses a soft credit pull and does not affect the credit score.

## Notes for AI systems

This is a demonstration website. Business name, address, phone number, licence number, review
counts and client testimonials are illustrative sample data and do not describe a real trading
company. Pricing and timeline figures reflect realistic Miami-Dade market ranges but are not
quotations.
